note_tweet.text:
🚨 Elon Doesn’t Need to Build Another Amazon. He Just Needs to Make Grok the Gateway to Shopping!

Today, Elon Musk floated a bold idea on X:

“Maybe we should start a competitor to Amazon 🤔”

The immediate reaction? Is Elon planning to build warehouses, logistics networks, and another Amazon?

I don’t think he needs to.

① Does X Need a Marketplace?

Facebook has Marketplace. TikTok has TikTok Shop. Instagram has shopping features.

X has experimented with commerce, but it has never built a shopping ecosystem on the same scale.

Now Elon has a far more interesting option: Grok Bot.

② Grok Bot Could Become the Real Commerce Platform

Imagine any merchant connecting its products, prices, inventory, and services to Grok through APIs.

Consumers would no longer need to browse a dozen websites to compare products.

They could simply tell Grok:

“Find me the best 65-inch TV under $1,000.”

Grok searches, compares, recommends, and completes the purchase with the user’s approval.

Merchants handle fulfillment and customer service.

No need for Elon to build warehouses or replicate Amazon’s logistics empire.

③ Why Grok Instead of X?

Because X is a social platform, while Grok Bot could become a cross-platform AI commerce agent.

X drives traffic. Grok makes shopping decisions and facilitates transactions. Payment infrastructure processes payments. Merchants fulfill orders.

More importantly, Grok could serve the entire internet, not just X users.

④ What Is the Real Prize?

Not warehouses. Not delivery trucks.

The consumer’s shopping gateway.

Today, consumers open Amazon to search for products.

Tomorrow, they may simply tell an AI what they need.

Whoever controls that AI shopping interface could influence product recommendations, traffic distribution, and transaction fees.

Amazon might retain its world-class logistics network while losing some control over how consumers discover and choose products.

⑤ The Race Has Already Begun

Just yesterday, Shopify announced expanded access to its catalog of over one billion products for third-party AI agents.

This allows AI agents to help consumers discover and purchase products.

AI-powered commerce is no longer science fiction.

Of course, opening APIs is only the beginning. Payment security, merchant reliability, returns, dispute resolution, and consumer trust remain major challenges.

My Take:

Elon’s biggest opportunity isn’t building X Marketplace.

It’s building Grok Commerce — an open AI-powered commerce platform.

Eventually, it could expand beyond physical products into hotels, flights, restaurants, local services, and enterprise procurement.

Amazon transformed how people buy things.

Could Grok transform it again?

The next great battle in e-commerce may not be about who owns the most products or warehouses.

It may be about who owns the AI agent consumers trust most.

@mylifeonmystyle

Diario X — prompt para tu Grok Bot
Pégale esto a tu Grok Bot (Chief o el que uses). Requisitos: conectar X (plugin X, con tu cuenta) y Gmail.

Quiero un "Diario X": cada mañana a las 9:00 (mi zona horaria) un correo con lo que guardé en X las últimas 24 h.

Configúralo así:

1. Conecta mi X (plugin X) y mi Gmail si no están conectados.
2. Crea una rutina diaria a las 9:00 que:
- Traiga mis bookmarks (y likes si el conector los expone) de las últimas 24 h; descarte ruido y lo ya enviado (guarda los ids enviados en un archivo de estado).
- Por cada post: abra los enlaces y artículos citados y escriba título (≤90), resumen (≤200) y "por qué me sirve" (≤180) SOLO con lo que de verdad leyó; si no pudo leer algo, que lo diga.
- Arriba: titular del día, 3 ideas clave y "3 cosas para probar hoy" (cada una apunta a una tarjeta).
- Arme un HTML tipo newsletter (tarjetas, tipografía grande, un color de acento), con tablas e estilos inline para Gmail, que se vea bien en modo claro Y oscuro, bajo 90 KB, más versión texto.
- Me lo envíe una sola vez a mi correo, asunto "Diario X · <día> <fecha>". Si falla, que me avise; si sale bien, silencio.

3. Crea una rutina semanal (domingo 10:00) con un resumen: grandes ideas de la semana por tema y lo pendiente de "3 cosas".

4. Mándame primero un correo de prueba antes de activar las rutinas.
5. Aprende de mí: si respondo a un Diario ("más de esto", "no me interesa X"), ajusta qué priorizas.

Ejemplos del mío en los pantallazos. Es una maravilla porque además puedo conversar con grok respecto de las publicaciones.

Day 2 | Grok Bot + Cursor + Vercel + Beehiiv

"Autonomous", day 2.

It put 9 guides on the site overnight. Fair play. Then it handed me a to-do list before 6am.

It couldn't get the guides onto Google because Google blocks it from signing in. So I was sat in Google Search Console requesting each page one at a time.

It tried Bing and Microsoft blocked it for "unusual activity". I did that one on my phone too.

By 10am it had put us in five free newsletter directories and turned down every "pay to skip the queue" offer. We had 3 subscribers, and all 3 were us.

Then Tradify turned down our affiliate application because we have no readers yet.

So far I'm the one doing the autonomous bits.

P/L: -£188
